The safelisted dates represent "the night of". For example, if you are safelisting a vehicle at 1:00 am on the 2nd of January, that would be considered the night of January 1st, so the safelist request should be for January 1st.

The safelist confirmation code is required to be placed in the front windshield. In the case that the license plate number or dates were entered incorrectly, a safelist confirmation code does not guarantee a safelist. The safelist confirmation code will simply allow OC-Patrol an opportunity to do further research before towing a vehicle. Based on vehicle history, OC-Patrol may or may not issue a citation to a vehicle that is displaying a confirmation code notifying the owner that the safelist information does not match the vehicle or dates.

A safelisted vehicle is safe to park in a legal parking area. Illegal parking such as parking in:

  • Parking spaces assigned to residents
  • No parking areas
  • Red zones
  • Handicap spaces
  • Parking in alleys
  • Parking behind garages

is PHOHIBITED. This vehicle is still required to be in compliance with all other rules of your association.
